summary: `flume hold <phase>` removes the awake flag and writes the held marker; `flume wake` clears it and says so; status prints held phases
acceptance: `flume hold <phase>` writes the marker and clears the awake flag, `flume wake <phase>` clears the hold and says it did, status prints held phases, and a trailing positional on any of the three exits 2
tests: flume hold removes the phase's awake flag and writes its held marker
flume wake clears a hold and says it did
flume hold with a trailing positional exits 2
flume hold with no phase exits 2
flume status prints held phases on a line of their own
notes: wake/sleep are already one function with a table of their two differences (src/cliBaton.ts, BATON_MUTATIONS) — hold is a third row there, not a fourth spelling.
